limitations: Model CLI and ownerHost are synthetic external boundaries; real application/API/store/scope were used.
Original raw owner/proxy log files were not retained. Receipt and policy-fault UI excerpts are recovered read-only from the exact worker tool transcript, not recreated as raw logs.
The worker used a short disposable data directory outside the single common root to meet the socket limit; this placement deviation is recorded and exact cleanup verified.
